svg.title: Same reads compared with each 10x barcode list
svg.desc: For public run SRR10953076, 97.4% of reads have a barcode on the 10x 3' v3 list. Every other 10x list matches 18.3% or less.
svg.text: Share of reads whose barcode is on each list (one base may differ)
With the wrong list, the pipeline still runs. It keeps fewer cells, and nothing tells you why.
First 100,000 reads of a run its lab records as 10x 3' v3, streamed from ENA. tchem 0.1.0 --all, 14 Oct 2026.
